record.field: Open the customer and complete the address and Accounting/ZATCA fields. For a Saudi B2B customer, review VAT number, district, building number, and additional number.
Tax currency requires a separate tax total

Correct the UBL XML generation for the next draft invoice. When TaxCurrencyCode is supplied, include a second document-level TaxTotal containing only TaxAmount, in that tax currency. Alternatively, do not output TaxCurrencyCode when it is not required.

Use the attached XML evidence and compare it with the standard Odoo ZATCA template. Do not edit or resubmit an invoice already accepted by ZATCA.
